title: Lantern Cove
subtitle: A light at the edge of the sea

key.name: Brass key
key.description: Small, salt-worn, and stamped with a lighthouse.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: A little flame sheltered behind blue glass.

shore.name: Quiet Shore
shore.text:
The tide has left a ribbon of silver along the sand. Above you, an unlit lighthouse watches the cove.

Something brass glints beside a piece of driftwood. A narrow path leads up to the keeper’s cottage.

actions.label: Follow the path to the cottage
Pick up the brass key
actions.text: You brush the sand from a small brass key.

actions.label: Watch the sea
actions.text: Far out in the mist, a fishing boat waits for a light to guide it home.

cottage.name: Keeper’s Cottage
cottage.text: The cottage smells of cedar and sea air. A lantern rests on the table. Beyond the open window, stone steps wind up to a locked lighthouse door.

actions.label: Take the lantern
actions.text: You lift the lantern. Its flame flickers, then steadies.

actions.label: Unlock the lighthouse
actions.text: The brass key turns. You climb the spiral stairs.

actions.label: Examine the lighthouse door
actions.text: A tiny lighthouse is engraved above the brass keyhole.

lighthouse.name: Lantern Room
lighthouse.text: Glass surrounds you on every side. Below, the cove is disappearing into fog. The great beacon is cold, but its wick is ready.

actions.label: Light the beacon with your lantern
actions.text:
You touch your lantern to the wick. Gold fills the glass, then reaches across the water.

From the cove comes the answering sound of a ship’s bell. The boat is coming home.

Your journey is complete.
